page.layout: One column of index entries, with the head "INDEX RERUM ET VERBORUM." above it. Letter headings A and B stand centred. Page numbers sit at the right of each entry. No margin notes, no page number, no catchword except "Beru-" at the foot right.

main_text.head: INDEX RERUM ET VERBORUM.
main_text.l: Antistes sacrorum apud Samaritanos de proge-
hodiè à Samaritanis pro vulgari usur-

page.notes: The Hebrew entries are reproduced as far as legible; the second and third lines and the number 520 are doubtful. The first entry's symbol looks like Hebrew ayin, but it is uncertain. The number "39. 42" appears with a raised second figure. The text at "usur-patur" is hyphenated across the line end. Printed spelling kept: "Chaldæi", "lingva", "pronuncietur", "carcer".
